verdict.rationale: Folk documents its own self-serve paths for bringing in real data: automatic Google contacts import and sync, Gmail and conversation sync, one-click LinkedIn profile imports, and contact-list import via its MCP. It also lists pipeline management as a plan feature, so the core ingredients of a quick self-built pipeline exist. Nothing in the evidence shows the time-to-value claim or the full signup-to-pipeline flow; the REST API and batch endpoints are developer building blocks and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of an under-an-hour setup, documented self-serve pipeline setup or onboarding guidance, CSV/spreadsheet or other-CRM migration tooling, and independent or hands-on corroboration that no implementation partner is needed.
